home.title: Expected End | Ebumnuche, e wuru n'ịma mma
home.description: Expected End na-emepụta software e chere echiche nke ọma, ngwaọrụ na-eme ka ọrụ dị ngwa, ahụmịhe dijitalụ, na obodo.

about.title: Maka Anyị | Expected End
about.description: Akụkọ Denzel Rigaud dị ka onye guzobere, ebumnuche dị n'azụ Expected End, na ọrụ ndị e wuru site n'okwukwe na ebumnuche.

denzel-rigaud.title: Denzel Rigaud | Onye Guzobere Expected End
denzel-rigaud.description: Denzel Rigaud bụ onye guzobere na onye mmepụta full-stack nọ n'azụ Expected End, MyBibleLens, Ngwa Ebe Nsọ Ndị Kraịst, na The Water Check.

press.title: Ndị Nta Akụkọ na Mgbasa Ozi | Expected End
press.description: Akụkọ ndụ a kwadoro, eziokwu e nyochara, njikọ njirimara, na mgbasa ozi ị nwere ike ibudata maka akụkọ gbasara Expected End na Denzel Rigaud.

terms.title: Usoro Iji Weebụsaịtị | Expected End
terms.description: Usoro na-achị iji weebụsaịtị Expected End.

privacy.title: Nkwupụta Nzuzo | Expected End
privacy.description: Otú Expected End si edozi ozi na weebụsaịtị a.

watercheck-privacy.title: Iwu Nzuzo The Water Check | Expected End
watercheck-privacy.description: Ihe The Water Check na-anakọta, ihe na-anọ na ekwentị gị, ndị na-enyere aka ịrụ ngwa ahụ, na nhọrọ gị.

watercheck-terms.title: Usoro na Ọnọdụ The Water Check | Expected End
watercheck-terms.description: Usoro maka iji ngwa The Water Check, gụnyere ahụike na nchekwa, AI, iwu Otu na ịzụ ihe.

watercheck-health-data.title: Iwu Nzuzo Data Ahụike Ndị Ahịa The Water Check | Expected End
watercheck-health-data.description: Otú The Water Check si edozi data ahụike ndị ahịa, na otú e si enweta ya, hichapụ ya ma ọ bụ mee mkpesa.

watercheck-delete-account.title: Hichapụ akaụntụ gị | The Water Check
watercheck-delete-account.description: Otú e si ehichapụ akaụntụ The Water Check gị na data gị, na ngwa ahụ ma ọ bụ site na email.

watercheck-community.title: Ụkpụrụ Obodo | The Water Check
watercheck-community.description: Otú Otu dị na The Water Check si anọgide na-adị mma: iwu, ịkpesa na igbochi, na ihe na-eme mgbe a dara iwu.

accessibility.title: Ịdị Mfe Iji | Expected End
accessibility.description: Nkwa Expected End maka weebụsaịtị onye ọ bụla nwere ike iji.

mybiblelens-store.title: Ụlọ Ahịa MyBibleLens | Expected End
mybiblelens-store.description: Ngwaahịa e chere echiche maka ije nso na Okwu ahụ. Ụlọ ahịa MyBibleLens na-abịa n'oge na-adịghị anya.

watercheck-store.title: Ụlọ Ahịa The Water Check | Expected End
watercheck-store.description: Ihe ndị dị mkpa sitere n'ịṅụ mmiri, site na The Water Check. Mwepụta mbụ na-abịa n'oge na-adịghị anya.

watercheck-page.title: The Water Check | Ngwa Ịṅụ Mmiri na Ihe Mgbako n'Efu
watercheck-page.description: Lelee ngwa The Water Check ma nwalee ntụle mmiri n'efu, na nzuzo, na Expected End.

watercheck-calculator.title: Ihe Mgbako Mmiri n'Efu | The Water Check
watercheck-calculator.description: Nweta ntụle mmiri kwa ụbọchị n'efu, na nzuzo, site n'ihe mgbako The Water Check.

not-found.title: Achọtaghị ibe ahụ | Expected End
not-found.description: Achọtaghị ibe Expected End a chọrọ.
